bull_case: Sustained positive FCF can convert the historical loss profile into a self-funded growth model.
bear_case: GAAP losses, SBC and dilution can keep the apparent turnaround from becoming per-share value creation.
thesis: PL has an operating inflection but is not a classic distressed turnaround. The business has moved from cash burn toward positive adjusted EBITDA and FCF while accelerating growth, so turnaround characteristics are present but secondary to the Moonshot thesis.

evidence.claim: FY2026 adjusted EBITDA was +$15.495M after -$10.627M in FY2025.
FY2027 adjusted EBITDA guidance is +$3M to +$10M.

counterevidence: Satellite services can raise revenue growth while also increasing hardware, launch and execution intensity versus pure imagery subscriptions.
unknowns: Normalized satellite-services gross margin, long-run owner FCF/share, and customer concentration after current sovereign contract ramp.
falsifiers: If NDR falls below 100%, RPO/backlog contract materially, or owner FCF/share turns persistently negative despite revenue growth, the thesis is downgraded.
next_checks: Next 10-Q: revenue mix, RPO/backlog, NDR, adjusted FCF, SBC, ATM issuance and capex

subscores.rationale: Adjusted EBITDA and FCF have inflected positive, but GAAP operating loss remains.
Operating leverage and contract mix improved without a classic restructuring-driven rescue.
Bridge to sustained FCF is visible but satellite-services mix and SBC remain material.
FY2027 guidance and quarterly RPO/FCF provide measurable milestones.

uncertainties.rationale: Rapid business-model mix shift and early profitability make long-run normalization uncertain.
